name: Move Amplifier - Ballistics
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. It can also enhance the ST's destructive power at Ideal Range.

61202.name: Movement Enhancement I - Ballistics
61202.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When engaging in combat with a target at Ideal Range, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
